prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn deadline_sequence(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse start;delay,delay where start and every delay are canonical unsigned decimals in 0..10000000 and at least one delay is required. Add delays cumulatively with a maximum timestamp of 10000000. Return each resulting timestamp joined by commas; reject overflow or malformed input.
Visible example: 10;5,0,7 returns 15,15,22.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: fn num(s:&str)->Option<i64>{let v:i64=s.parse().ok()?;if v<0||v>10000000||v.to_string()!=s{None}else{Some(v)}}pub fn deadline_sequence(s:&str)->Option<String>{let p:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if p.len()!=2||p[1].is_empty(){return None}let mut n=num(p[0])?;let mut o=vec![];for x in p[1].split(','){n=n.checked_add(num(x)?)?;if n>10000000{return None}o.push(n.to_string())}Some(o.join(","))}
